title: Portal Lock: Dimension Control
description: Lock Nether and End portals behind items. Players must have specific items to enter dimensions. Fully configurable and server-friendly.
body:
“In modern Minecraft, players can reach the Nether instantly even on first login with just a water bucket and lava pool. Have you ever questioned this?”


Portal Lock is a lightweight and highly configurable Paper plugin that allows you to restrict access to the Nether and End using required items.

Perfect for servers and modpacks that want progression-based gameplay.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ Features
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✔ Require items to enter Nether and End
✔ Supports walking, boats, and minecarts
✔ Items are only consumed when entering (not when returning)
✔ Fully configurable (items, amounts, sounds, messages)
✔ Supports minecraft: style IDs
✔ Chat or Actionbar display modes
✔ Per-player language support (auto-detect client language)
✔ 10 built-in languages included
✔ Reload command support
✔ Permission-based bypass system

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌍 Language Support
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Portal Lock automatically detects each player's Minecraft language and displays messages accordingly.

Supported languages:
- English (en_us)
- Japanese (ja_jp)
- German (de_de)
- French (fr_fr)
- Spanish (es_es)
- Portuguese (pt_br)
- Italian (it_it)
- Korean (ko_kr)
- Chinese (zh_cn)
- Russian (ru_ru)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⚙️ Configuration
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Everything is configurable:

- Required items (Nether / End)
- Required item amount
- Sounds (success / fail)
- Pitch & volume
- Message display mode (chat / actionbar)
- Language mode (auto / fixed)

Supports multiple ID formats:

- GLOWSTONE
- glowstone
- minecraft:glowstone

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔐 Permissions
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

portallock.reload
portallock.bypass
portallock.bypass.nether
portallock.bypass.end

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
⌨️ Commands
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

/portallock reload

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 Use Cases
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Survival progression servers
- RPG servers
- Hardcore challenges
- Modpack-style progression

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🛠 Requirements
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

- Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21
